title: Avoid recomputing capture status in do_move
rationale: Current Stockfish PR #7199 avoids recomputing capture_stage(move) inside do_move when the caller already knows capture status. The upstream STC passed at LLR 2.94 with 137152 games (34973 W / 34548 L / 67631 D), and the change is explicitly non-functional. FayE still has the pre-change do_move implementation, so this is a small isolated efficiency candidate with direct architectural fit and no NNUE feature duplication.

protocol.stage: small paired screen plus NPS microbenchmark

promotion_rule: Do not merge from this screen. Promote only if functional bench is identical and the combined strength/efficiency signal is not clearly adverse; then run a larger Fishtest-style confirmation on UHO_Lichess_4852_v1.
notes: One mechanism only: pass already-computed capture status into do_move.
No NNUE architecture or relational feature changes.
Patch is generated from a pinned upstream PR head/base and restricted to src/search.cpp and src/search.h.
FAYE-0001 rejected; FAYE-0002 no-promotion; FAYE-0003 no-promotion. This experiment uses a different mechanism.
